items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He had the band down at Jimmy Ryan's for a little while, after...

ctx.x: You played the Olympia. Did you play the Salle Pleyel in Paris? Because there are some recordings with Mezz Mezzrow in November of '54... But what did he do? He contacted you and he said he was going abroad?

No, I worked with him a little bit here in New York. He used to sit in... He had the band down at Jimmy Ryan's for a little while, after... I was down there with Sidney Bechet for a while. Then Sidney Bechet got a chance
